subject: general
question: In ΔABC, AB = 48 cm, BC = 55 cm and AC = 73 cm. If O is the centroid of the triangle, then the length (in cm) of BO (correct to one decimal place) is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Identify the sides 48, 55, 73 as a Pythagorean triplet since 48² + 55² = 73².

In a right-angled triangle, the median to the hypotenuse is half the hypotenuse: 73 ÷ 2 = 36.5 cm.

The centroid O lies at 2/3 of the median length from the vertex B.

BO = 2/3 × 36.5 = 73 ÷ 3 = 24.33... cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 24.3 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** AB = 48 cm, BC = 55 cm, AC = 73 cm. O is the centroid.

**Formula Used:** Median to hypotenuse = Hypotenuse ÷ 2; Distance of centroid from vertex = 2/3 × Median.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/691aee23118803174cea1fb07e6b56f2548b84108048105ad127f0cf8b7f6fb8.png] 

⇒ Verify right triangle: 48² + 55² = 2304 + 3025 = 5329

⇒ AC² = 73² = 5329

⇒ Since AB² + BC² = AC², ΔABC is right-angled at B.

⇒ Median to hypotenuse BD = AC ÷ 2 = 73 ÷ 2 = 36.5 cm.

⇒ BO = 2/3 × BD

⇒ BO = 2/3 × 36.5 = 73 ÷ 3

⇒ BO = 24.333... ≈ 24.3 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 24.3 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Median to Hypotenuse Property

In any right-angled triangle, the length of the median drawn to the hypotenuse is exactly half the length of the hypotenuse and is also equal to the circumradius (R) of the triangle.

Centroid Division Rule

The centroid of a triangle divides each median in the ratio 2:1, where the larger part (2 units) is the segment connecting the centroid to the vertex.

Pythagorean Triplets

Common triplets used in exams include (3, 4, 5), (5, 12, 13), (7, 24, 25), (8, 15, 17), (9, 40, 41), (11, 60, 61), (12, 35, 37), and (48, 55, 73).</p
